founder.alt: Kate Belova, founder of Photo Italy
founder.bio1: Kate Belova is a professional portrait and lifestyle photographer with over 10 years of experience, based in Rome, Italy. Known for her "soul portrait" style, Kate has a rare ability to make people feel completely at ease in front of the camera — revealing authentic emotions and genuine personality in every frame.
founder.bio2: After years of shooting family and lifestyle sessions across Rome, Tuscany, and Portofino, Kate realized that tourists visiting Italy wanted beautiful photos but finding a trustworthy local photographer was surprisingly hard. She created Photo Italy to solve this — a curated marketplace where every photographer is personally vetted and every session delivers an exceptional experience.

about.metaTitle: About us — our story and mission

ourMission.text1: We believe every trip to Italy deserves to be captured beautifully. That's why we created Photo Italy — a platform where travelers can instantly find and book talented local photographers who know the best spots, the perfect timing, and how to make you feel comfortable in front of the camera.

theProblem.text: Italy is one of the most photogenic countries in Europe. Rome's golden light, Florence's dramatic riverfront, Tuscany's fairytale villages, the Amalfi Coast's raw coastal beauty — it's a photographer's dream. Yet every year, millions of tourists come home with nothing but blurry selfies and awkward "can you take our photo?" shots from strangers.

locationsCovered.text: From the streets of Rome to the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast, from Val d'Orcia vineyards to volcanic Sardinia — we cover all of Italy.

items.a: Yes. We hand-vet every photographer. You should have a strong portfolio, professional equipment, and experience shooting paid sessions. Hobbyists are not accepted.

items.a: You must be based in Italy or legally able to work here. Most of our photographers live in or near the locations they serve (Rome, Florence, the Amalfi Coast, etc.).

items.a: We charge a 15% platform fee on each booking (reduced to 10% for Premium plan). You keep the rest. No upfront costs and no subscription required to get started.
items.q: How much do you take from each booking?

items.a: Clients pay through Stripe when they book. Funds are released to you 24 hours after the client accepts the delivered photos. Payouts go directly to your bank account.
items.q: How and when do I get paid?

items.a: Two ways: (1) Clients browse our catalog and book you directly, and (2) Our concierge team hand-picks photographers for client requests — you just confirm the booking.
Usually 1–3 business days. We review your portfolio, check your identity, and make sure your profile meets our quality standards.

cancelReschedule.answer:
Yes. You can cancel or reschedule through your dashboard.

**Cancellation refunds:**
• 7+ days before the shoot — 100% refund
• 3–7 days before — 50% refund
• Less than 3 days — No refund
• No-show — No refund

**Rescheduling:** You get one free reschedule if requested 48+ hours before the session. Rescheduling within 48 hours is at the photographer's discretion. Weather-related rescheduling is always free.

**If the photographer cancels or reschedules:** You always receive a 100% full refund, regardless of timing. If the cancellation happens less than 48 hours before the shoot, Photo Italy will try to find a replacement photographer for you.

contactSupport.answer:
You can reach our support team through:

• **Email:** {email}
• **Dashboard:** Photographers can submit support tickets directly from their dashboard
• **Contact page:** Visit our contact page to send us a message

We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours during business days.

forcesMajeure.answer:
In case of force majeure events — natural disasters, severe weather warnings, pandemics, or other circumstances beyond anyone's control — both parties are entitled to a full refund or free reschedule with no penalties.

Photo Italy will work with both parties to find the best solution.

chooseAnyPhotographer.answer:
Yes — the gift card works with any **participating** Photo Italy photographer across Italy. The recipient browses our full catalog in gift mode and books like a normal session. Photographers opt in by default; a small number choose to opt out, and those are simply hidden from the gift catalog.

The recipient has full freedom: pick anyone, anywhere in Italy, any date that works for both of you.

externalLinks.answer:
No. Photographers are not allowed to include personal website URLs, social media links (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc.), email addresses, or phone numbers anywhere on their profile — including bio, tagline, package descriptions, and portfolio captions.

All communication with clients must go through Photo Italy's built-in messaging system. This protects both parties by keeping conversations documented, payments secure, and disputes resolvable.

Profiles found to contain external links or contact information will be asked to remove them. Repeated violations may result in account suspension.

photographerCancels.answer:
If you need to cancel, do so through your dashboard as early as possible. The client always receives a 100% refund regardless of timing.

If you cancel less than 48 hours before the shoot, Photo Italy may attempt to find a replacement photographer for the client.

**Important:** Repeated cancellations (3 or more in 3 months) may result in loss of Featured status, reduced search visibility, or account suspension.
